ABOUT ATLAS ALPINE

A Nepal-based
expedition company
for the world’s
highest mountains.

Atlas Alpine Expedition brings together local mountain knowledge and a deep respect for the Himalaya. We lead climbs, treks, and alpine journeys shaped by the mountains, the people, and the places that make Nepal extraordinary.
